metaDescription: FLYCRAN's personal site: frontend architect focused on Developer Experience and frontend infrastructure.
profileIntro: I'm Flycran. I've built TypeScript language-service plugins, Vite plugins, CLIs and a few small tools people actually use; I like turning problems teams run into again and again into one-time solutions.
homeWorkNote: Every project comes with a live demo.

projects$2Subtitle: Jump straight from hook to endpoint
projects$2Summary: Lets RTK Query hooks jump to their endpoint definitions, showing the URL and HTTP method on hover.
projects$3Description: An Astro static site, zero database, paper-craft design system. This page is its own case study: bookmark navigation, paper-crane motion, printable résumé.
homeAboutNote: Why I build tools, and how I work with teams.
homeAboutLead: I started out building pages, and got more and more curious about why anyone should have to do the same thing by hand twice.
homeAboutCraft: These days I work on frontend architecture and developer tooling: types, builds and editors remember the rules so teams can spend their time on the product. I like turning recurring problems into one-time solutions, and drawing complex things until they're clear.
homeAboutTeam: The team I'm looking for: one that cares about engineering quality and goes an extra step for the experience; has real users and real feedback; and treats “it runs” as the starting point.
principles$0: Tools should make the next step clearer.
principles$1: Documentation is part of the product.
principles$2: Correct first, then elegant; measure first, then optimize.
principles$3: Motion either explains structure or gives feedback — otherwise cut it.
